facts.fact: Figures presented at the PNER financing round table put rural access to electricity at 25.7% (51.1% nationally); the AGER director general separately cited 23% for rural people.
The UN System in Guinea says rural household access to electricity rose from 2 percent in 2018 to 7 percent in 2023.
